notes.map-bg: Opaque 640x360 level-select map, shown at x2 (1280x720). Pixen 640x360 (seed 2050), snapped to palette32 locally, plus a sparse heat dither over the downtown corner (x>=578, y<=240). Districts: green park bottom-left (level 1), dense houses centre (2), factories right (3), hot downtown top-right (4). No baked text.
notes.nodes: Markers are drawn locally. Draw them centred on the map-layout.json node points (anchor 0.5, 0.5). current has a single frame: animate the pulse in code (scale or tint tween).
notes.path: map-path-dot is placed every ~10 native px along the map-layout.json polylines.
notes.layout: src/assets/pixel/map/map-layout.json holds the node points and the paths in native 640x360 coordinates.
notes.icons: icon-heatwave / icon-delivery are 24x24 HUD/map icons kept in the map area (ART-MAP may only write map/ and new world/ files). 4 px transparent margin like the ui icons.
notes.worldAdditions: World sprites for levels 3-4 are listed in art/map/world-additions.json (merge into art/world/manifest.json).
